scripts.dev:api: cd backend && (test -f venv/bin/uvicorn && ./venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 || uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000)
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (test -f venv/bin/uvicorn && ./venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 || uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000)
